## Work

- [ ] Under the right model section `## <Model name> (<maker>)` (new section added if the model is new)
- [ ] Under a kind-of-work `###` heading (demo, figure, 3D scene, game, …)
- [ ] Primary source URL where the model produced the work + date
- [ ] Still at `media/<model-slug>/<work-slug>.<ext>`
- [ ] Prompt or brief included only if it was published
- [ ] One or two lines on what the model produced; no metrics or claims beyond the source
- [ ] Evidence boundary
- [ ] Entry added to both README.md and README.zh.md
- [ ] No unpublished data or private coordinates
